//: This project deploys as a Docker Compose stack (see DEPLOYMENT.md) and is
not a Vercel application. No 'builds' or 'framework' entry is defined,
which is not an oversight: Vercel applies zero-config framework detection
and will otherwise attempt a FastAPI build for any repository containing a
pyproject.toml. That build cannot succeed here -- the API is served by
server.py via gunicorn/uvicorn, so there is no module-level ASGI 'app' for
Leaving the attempted build in place produces a permanently failing check on
every pull request, which trains reviewers to ignore red checks. Stating the
unsupported target is clearer than a build nobody can fix.
If a Vercel deployment is ever wanted, it must target the frontend with
'rootDirectory: frontend' and a VITE_API_BASE pointing at a separately
hosted API, not this repository root.
